day_local: Arbacada Toddobaadkii Labaad iyo Tobnaad ee Wakhtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda iyo nimcada Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential:
Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
Masiixow, noo naxariiso.
Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
psalm_response: Waxaad biyo farxad leh ka dhaansan doontaan ilaha badbaadada.
homily:
Waxaa jira daqiiqado maalinta ka mid ah, gaar ahaan marka qorraxdu ay bilaabato inay hoos u dhacdo, oo gurigu uu noqdo mid aamusan, halkaas oo xusuustu ay si tartiib ah u soo gasho qolka. Waxaad arki kartaa wax yar oo maalinle ah: laga yaabee inay tahay diyaarad yar oo uu Ben ku ciyaari jiray, ama buug uu dhigay miiska, ama xataa xusuusta qosolkiisa markuu ka hadlayo 'con chim airlines'. Waxyaalahan yaryar, oo aan muhiim u muuqan, ayaa ah meesha aan maanta ka bilaabayno. Waxay yihiin xusuus muujinaysa in nolosha Benjamin Vo ay ahayd mid dhab ah, mid qurux badan, oo weli halkan nala joogta. Waxaan maanta dooraneynaa hal sawir oo nala socda: waa sawirka 'ilaha biyaha' ee aan ku aragno Sabuurka maanta. 'Waxaad biyo farxad leh ka dhaansan doontaan ilaha badbaadada.' Biyuhu waa nolosha. Biyuhu waa waxa nadiifiya, waxa harraadka tiriya, waxa dib u soo nooleeya wax kasta oo engegay. Benjamin wuxuu ahaa il biyo nadiif ah oo qoyskiisa u soo kordhiyey farxad iyo nabad.

Bawlos, akhriska koowaad, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'To me, the very least of all the holy ones, this grace was given, to preach to the Gentiles the inscrutable riches of Christ.' (Aniga, oo ah kan ugu yar quduusiinta, nimcadan ayaa la i siiyey, si aan dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn ugu wacdiyo hodantinimada aan la baari karin ee Masiixa). Bal ka feker ereyadaas. 'Hodantinimada aan la baari karin.' Benjamin wuxuu ahaa wiil hodan ku ahaa caqli, laakiin ka sii muhiimsan, wuxuu hodan ku ahaa jacayl. Wuxuu ahaa wiil leh maskax aad u fiiqan, oo yaqaanay sida loo darsado AWS environments, ama sida loo qoro koodhka GitHub, laakiin wuxuu kaloo ahaa wiil arkayay waxa dadka kale aysan arag: baahida dadka kale iyo jacaylka qoyskiisa. Wuxuu ahaa wiil jecel inuu barto diyaaradaha, isagoo maskaxdiisa ku dhisayay shirkad uu u bixiyay 'con chim airlines', halkaas oo uu ka qosli jiray oo uu si farxad leh uga sheekeyn jiray.

Laakiin intaanan halkaas sii marin, waa inaan si daacad ah u wajahno xanuunka weyn ee maanta halkan yaalla. Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo qoto dheer oo culayskooda wata. Waxaa jira saacado marka qorraxdu dhacdo ama marka gurigu aamuso, oo aad dareemaysaan inaysan jirin wax buuxin kara cisrigaas banaanka ah. Waxaan rabaa inaan halkan ku hakinno. Waxaan rabaa inaan idiin sheego runta: Ilaah wuu idin arkaa. Wuxuu arkaa oohintiinna, wuxuu arkaa dadaalkiinna, wuxuu arkaa jacaylka aad weli u hayso Ben. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Waxaan rabaa inaan si gaar ah u xuso in xanuunkan uusan ahayn khaladkiinna. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwa weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' (Midna isagu midna waalidkiis). Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah.

Oo halkaas ayay nuurku ka soo galayaa qolka mugdiga ah. Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'You also must be prepared, for at an hour you do not expect, the Son of Man will come.' (Idinkuna waa inaad diyaar ahaataan, waayo saacad aydun filayn ayuu Wiilka Aadanaha iman doonaa). Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil mar walba diyaar u ahaa inuu dadka kale la wadaago waxa uu haysto. Xusuusnow sida uu u rabay inuu u huro lacagtiisa si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa dabeecadda wiilkan qalbiga wanaagsan. Taasi waa waxa ay ka dhigan tahay in lagu dhex noolaado xornimada Masiixa. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil loo doortay inuu iftiimiyo adduunkan. Hadda, Ben wuxuu ku jiraa meel ka sarreysa daruuraha, meel aanay jirin xanuun ama daal. Wuxuu ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven'. Ma jiro baahi loo qabo inuu dhisayo 'con chim airlines', waayo wuxuu ku jiraa meel uu ka arki karo adduunka oo dhan, isagoo dhoola caddaynaya.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro xusuustaada, riyooyinkaaga, iyo jacaylka aad wadaagteen. Ha ka cabsin inaad horay u socoto. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Wuxuu rabaa inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay: 'Ha ka baqina, waayo waxaan idin sugayaa meel aan dhimasho lahayn.'

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in ilaha biyaha ee badbaadada ay weli socdaan. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciisow, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan ku jeclahay wax walba, waxaana rabaa inaan naftayda ku siiyo. Maadaama aanan hadda si dhab ah kuu qaadan karin, fadlan naftayda ku soo gal si ruuxi ah. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidii aad horay u joogtay, waxaana naftayda ku xirayaa adiga. Ha ii oggolaan inaan weligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa weligeed ah. Aamiin.
petition_call: Waxaan Rabbiga u baryeynaa inuu maqlo codsigeenna.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyey ee dhintay, inuu Rabbigu ku soo dhaweeyo iftiinkiisa iyo nabaddiisa weligeed ah, ayaannu Rabbiga u baryeynaa.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan iyo kuwa xanuunka dareemaya, inuu Ilaah ku mannaysto rajo, xoog, iyo qalbi-qaboojin, ayaannu Rabbiga u baryeynaa.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal, waad maqasheen wakiilnimada nimcada Ilaah ee lay siiyey si aan idiin anfaco, taas oo ah, in qarsoodiga lay ogeysiiyey xagga muujinta, siday kor ku qoran tahay. Markaad tan akhridaan, waad fahmi kartaan garaadkayga ku saabsan qarsoodiga Masiixa, kaas oo aan loo ogeysiin bini'aadamka jiilalkii hore sidii hadda loogu muujiyey Rasuulladiisa iyo nebiyadiisa quduuska ah xagga Ruuxa, in dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn ay yihiin dhaxaltooyo, xubno ka mid ah isku jidh, iyo wada-hawlgalayaasha ballanka ee Masiixa Ciise xagga Injiilka. Tan waxaan u noqday adeegayaal xagga hadiyadda nimcada Ilaah ee lay siiyey si waafaqsan awooddiisa. Aniga, oo ah kan ugu yar quduusiinta, nimcadan ayaa la i siiyey, si aan dadka aan Yuhuudda ahayn ugu wacdiyo hodantinimada aan la baari karin ee Masiixa, iyo inaan iftiimiyo qorshaha qarsoodiga ah ee qarniyadii hore ku qarsoonaa Ilaah oo wax walba abuuray, si xigmadda Ilaah ee badan hadda loogu ogeysiiyo xagga Kaniisadda kuwa xukunka leh iyo kuwa awoodda leh ee samada. Tan waxaa loo sameeyey si waafaqsan ujeeddada weligeed ah ee uu ku dhammaystiray Masiixa Ciise oo Rabbigeenna ah, kaas oo aynu ku leenahay geesinimada hadalka iyo kalsoonida gelitaanka xagga rumaysadka aynu isaga ku qabno.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Waxaad biyo farxad leh ka dhaansan doontaan ilaha badbaadada. Ilaah runtii waa badbaadiyahayga; waan kalsoonahay mana cabsanayo. Rabbigu waa xooggayga iyo geesinimadayda, isaga ayaana ii noqday badbaadiye. R. Waxaad biyo farxad leh ka dhaansan doontaan ilaha badbaadada. Rabbiga u mahadnaqa, oo magiciisa ku ammaana; quruumaha dhexdooda ku ogeysiiya falimihiisa, oo ku dhawaaqa siday magiciisu u sarreeyo. R. Waxaad biyo farxad leh ka dhaansan doontaan ilaha badbaadada. Rabbiga ammaan ku gabya, waayo wuxuu sameeyey waxyaalo ammaano leh; ha lagu ogaado tan dhulka oo dhan. Ku dhawaaqa farxad, dadka Siyoonow, waayo kan Quduuska ah ee reer binu Israa'iil ayaa dhexdiinna ku weyn! R. Waxaad biyo farxad leh ka dhaansan doontaan ilaha badbaadada.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu xertiisii ku yidhi: “Hubsada tan: haddii sayidka gurigu ogaan lahaa saacadda uu tuuggu imanayo, gurigiisa uma oggolaadeen in la jebiyo. Idinkuna waa inaad diyaar ahaataan, waayo saacad aydun filayn ayuu Wiilka Aadanaha iman doonaa.” Markaasuu Butros yidhi, “Rabbiyow, ma annaga mise qof walba ayaa masaalkan loogu talagalay?” Rabbiguna wuxuu ugu jawaabay, “Haddaba waa kuma wakiilka aaminka ah oo caqliga leh oo sayidkiisu u dhiibi doono addoommadiisa si uu u qaybiyo raashinka waqtiga ku habboon? Waxaa barakaysan addoonka sayidkiisu marka uu yimaado uu helo isagoo sidaas samaynaya. Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, wuxuu u dhiibi doonaa hantidiisa oo dhan. Laakiin haddii addoonkaas uu naftiisa u yidhaahdo, ‘Sayidkaygu wuu daahayaa inuu yimaado,’ oo uu bilaabo inuu garaaco addoommada iyo addoommadii, oo uu cuno oo uu cabbo oo uu sakhraamo, markaas sayidka addoonkaas wuxuu iman doonaa maalin aan la filayn iyo saacad aan la aqoon, wuxuuna ciqaabi doonaa addoonka si adag, wuxuuna u qoondeyn doonaa meel la mid ah kuwa aan aaminka ahayn. Addoonkaas oo ogaa sayidkiisa doonistiisa laakiin aan diyaargarow samayn ama aan u dhaqmin si waafaqsan doonistiisa, ayaa si adag loo garaaci doonaa; addoonka aan ogeyn sayidkiisa doonistiisa laakiin sameeyey wixii u qalmay garaacis adag, ayaa lagu garaaci doonaa si fudud. Qofka loo dhiibay wax badan ayaa wax badan laga rabaa, qofka loo dhiibay wax ka sii badan ayaa wax ka sii badan laga dalban doonaa.”

day: Wednesday of the Twenty-ninth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!
